SELECT
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-02 00:00') utc_all,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-02 00:00' AND status<>'cancelled') utc_nc,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 22:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 22:00') hel_all,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 22:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 22:00' AND status<>'cancelled') hel_nc,
 count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FILTER (WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 22:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 22:00') hel_distinct,
 count(*) total_rows, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) total_distinct

SELECT w.status, count(*) n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.n_lines IS NULL) no_lines, min(w.order_ts_utc) mn, max(w.order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order w LEFT JOIN (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) n_lines FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' GROUP BY 1) s ON s.receipt_id=w.web_order_id
WHERE w.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 22:00' AND w.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 22:00'
GROUP BY 1

FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', order_ts_utc)) AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
